$comment: Generated by tools/generate_rpc_schema.py from specs/rpc/{methods,contracts,field_policies}.json; do not edit.
title: Orion2 RPC client request contracts (optional runtime, disabled by default)
description: Root includes planned acknowledged client request contracts; only x-rpc-implementedMethods are dispatchable in an enabled build. Response and server-notification entry points are in $defs. UTF-8 byte, lexical integer, depth, duplicate-key and authorization rules require the protocol guards; x-* annotations are not standard JSON Schema assertions.

AgreementLevel.description: Signed cached native agreement level, in the accompanying per-turn RP or BC unit. Not the hidden goal, growth or a forecast.

CachedShipTurns.description: Nonnegative whole turns as displayed by the native UI.

ColonyResourceValue.description: Value represented by a native colony resource icon group: each tens icon represents 10 and each unit icon 1. Preserves the renderer's signed-byte import branch and suppression; not a newly calculated economic total.

ColonyTroopCount.description: Nonnegative integer count of authorized projected records only.

ColonyTroopHP.description: Unsigned-byte HP value displayed by the native troop popup, including its native byte conversion; not an entity health record.

ColonyTroopStrength.description: Signed strength in the normal own-colony troop popup, from its native defensive summary producer; not a combat forecast or an enemy statistic.

Coord.description: Native unscaled galaxy-map coordinate; not a window pixel or distance in parsecs.

Count.description: Nonnegative integer count of authorized projected records only.

Counter.description: Unsigned decimal string, monotonically increasing within its documented identity scope.

Credits.description: Whole displayed billion credits, not a hidden economic intermediate.

DesignCost.description: Stored integer design/instance production cost; a committed refit record stores its refit cost. Not BC, a purchase price, or a recalculated current build cost.

DisplayedWeaponCount.description: Nonnegative integer count of authorized projected records only.

FoodSurplus.description: Signed displayed food surplus per turn.

HistoryScale.description: Native chart axis label after series selection, quantization and optional smoothing; not an exact historical statistic or an inverse conversion of graph endpoints.

HistorySpacing.description: Integer in the native 640x480 logical viewport, independent of window scale.

HistoryY.description: Integer in the native 640x480 logical viewport, independent of window scale.

HudCount.description: Signed integer displayed by the native HUD, including negative available freighters or command points; not a hidden capacity or allocation count.

Id.description: Unpredictable handle scoped to its owning connection, game or authorized perspective; never a native slot.

Income.description: Signed displayed BC per turn, including native HUD net income or an individual agreement level; not gross production.

InstalledWeaponCount.description: Nonnegative integer count of authorized projected records only.

Key.description: Locally configured shared key, decoded from native CP850 settings to UTF-8 and compared exactly; never returned by the service.

LeaderUpkeep.description: Signed displayed BC per turn, including native HUD net income or an individual agreement level; not gross production.

MoraleIcons.description: Signed displayed happy/unhappy icon count, native morale divided by two toward zero and capped at 20 icons; suppressed governments disclose no raw morale or inferred percentage.

NebulaVariant.description: Signed displayed native slider value or score points; the owning context supplies and enforces its current range.

Orbit.description: One-based physical orbital position 1..5, not the compressed occupied-slot ordinal used by native planet names.

PageSize.description: Nonnegative integer count of authorized projected records only.

PixelX.description: Integer in the native 640x480 logical viewport, independent of window scale.

PixelY.description: Integer in the native 640x480 logical viewport, independent of window scale.

PlanetClimate.description: Signed displayed native slider value or score points; the owning context supplies and enforces its current range.

PlanetFood2.description: Native half-food units per farmer: 5 represents the displayed 2.5 Food, not a recalculated colony yield.

PlanetGravity.description: Signed displayed native slider value or score points; the owning context supplies and enforces its current range.

PlanetGravityPenalty.description: Whole native percentage; field-specific bounds distinguish gravity penalties, tribute and signed intelligence bonuses.

PlanetMinerals.description: Signed displayed native slider value or score points; the owning context supplies and enforces its current range.

PlanetPopulationLimit.description: Nonnegative integer count of authorized projected records only.

PlanetProductivity.description: Nonnegative integer count of authorized projected records only.

PlanetSize.description: Signed displayed native slider value or score points; the owning context supplies and enforces its current range.

PlanetSpecial.description: Signed displayed native slider value or score points; the owning context supplies and enforces its current range.

PlayerColor.description: Native empire banner palette index 0..7, not a native player slot or an RGB value.

ProductionPoints.description: Native displayed production points: current product cost, stored and purchased production. Not BC or an RPC completion forecast.

RelationIndicatorOffset.description: Native relationship indicator Y offset in logical pixels relative to the bar top. One of the native 26 remapped positions, not an exact attitude score.

ResearchPoints.description: Native displayed research points. Total field cost and change-research remaining cost are distinct; neither is a guaranteed breakthrough threshold.

ResourceData.description: Encoded bytes, not characters. Base64 data is bounded separately from decoded resource size.

ShipCombatSpeed.description: Whole native displayed combat movement units, after native damage rounding and trait bonuses; no movement options or forecast.

ShipEvasion.description: Whole native percentage; field-specific bounds distinguish gravity penalties, tribute and signed intelligence bonuses.

ShipExperience.description: Whole owned combat-ship crew experience points displayed as EP in Fleets; noncombat experience is not inferred.

ShipHits.description: Exact integer current/maximum structure or armor hits displayed in owned ship detail; preserves signed native exceptional values without clamping or predicting repair.

ShipRating.description: Signed whole beam attack/defense rating displayed in owned ship detail, not a probability or combat forecast.

ShipShieldStrength.description: Exact integer current/maximum structure or armor hits displayed in owned ship detail; preserves signed native exceptional values without clamping or predicting repair.

ShipWarpSpeed.description: Whole native displayed drive speed, including the owner's native trans-dimensional bonus where displayed; suppressed drive presentations retain their native displayed zero, not a calculated ETA.

ShortText.description: UTF-8 rendered text, converted from the selected local game language; no raw format arguments.

SpectralClass.description: Signed displayed native slider value or score points; the owning context supplies and enforces its current range.

SpyCount.description: Nonnegative integer count of authorized projected records only.

SpyPercent.description: Whole native percentage; field-specific bounds distinguish gravity penalties, tribute and signed intelligence bonuses.

StarSize.description: Signed displayed native slider value or score points; the owning context supplies and enforces its current range.

Text.description: UTF-8 rendered text, converted from the selected local game language; no raw format arguments.

TributeFive.description: Whole native percentage; field-specific bounds distinguish gravity penalties, tribute and signed intelligence bonuses.

TributeTen.description: Whole native percentage; field-specific bounds distinguish gravity penalties, tribute and signed intelligence bonuses.

Turn.description: Committed native turn/stardate integer, not a screen transition or wall-clock timestamp.

Turns.description: Nonnegative whole turns as displayed by the native UI.

Value.description: Signed displayed native slider value or score points; the owning context supplies and enforces its current range.

colony-heading.predicate: Only the same capture's authorized own full colony. Share the native colony heading's localized specialty/annihilation formatter and 104-byte final buffer, with caller-owned 31-byte native planet-name output instead of the selected-colony/global temp-string buffer. Missing initialized format/name resources is unknown. This heading grants no foreign colony or extra entity record, and carries no invented occupation recommendation, action or forecast.

colony-garrison.predicate: Bound viewer's own full colony only, after parent-link/population validation and authorized own leader inputs. Share the normal troop popup's pure Compute_Colony_Ground_Combat_Info with include_rebels=false, using caller-owned output. Its helpers read own technology/traits and present armor, infantry and population militia counts, signed native strength and the popup's uint8 HP conversion. Player_Troop_Name preserves tank/battloid and ordinary/powered infantry labels even for zero-count rows. No opponent argument, rebellion result, simulated battle, casualty/RNG path, foreign treasury, strength forecast or newly resolvable technology/leader/design record. Missing/stale leader inputs make this block unknown while cached military counts remain available. These rows describe native current presentation, not permission to produce or deploy a unit.

contract.predicate: Only copied protocol metadata or already authorized projected values; never read native memory here.

request.predicate: Caller-supplied intent only; exact typed validation, authorization and generation recheck before use.

session.predicate: Only the explicitly authorized local perspective. Omit game/perspective/revision/turn before a game is loaded and after revocation; publish committed turn only, not intermediate calculation.

systems-map.predicate: Only systems whose native map position is drawn for this player. Coordinates are native star coordinates, before zoom/pan. ID assigned after this predicate; no slot-derived numbering.

system-name.predicate: Non-black-hole name only: Player_Is_Omniscient(viewer), or valid native dominant visible owner plus Contact_With_One_Colony, or Player_Has_Visited. Copy bounded CP850 and reproduce rendered outpost lowercase and unvisited foreign Lore parentheses; otherwise unknown. Temporary contact/Lore-only grants expire through existing whole-view revocation on mutation or observed authority loss. Get_Star_Name is evidence, NOT a pure query helper: it changes font/zoom state and may allocate a bitmap.

system-visited.predicate: Only the bound player's visited bit, never the complete bitmask. Does not grant planet/owner/special disclosure.

system-name-visited.predicate: Initial runtime subset: bound human viewer has visited and star is not a black hole. Copy bounded CP850 name, apply native ASCII outpost lowercase on the copy, then decode UTF-8. Contact/lore-only unvisited names remain explicitly unaudited; no UI/font/resource builder is called.

nebulas-map.predicate: Native map draws every existing nebula without a viewer gate. Publish unscaled map x/y and uint8(type) modulo 12 rendered variant with perspective-scoped opaque IDs. Never raw type, hidden gameplay star membership or art/cache pointers.

system-owner.predicate: Native Star_Owner dominant visible owner: self preferred, otherwise largest contact-filtered colony count with native tie order; omniscience removes contact filtering. This is not exclusive ownership. Resolve only a same-capture known-player handle; unknown if unavailable. Do not read foreign economy or trust cached star.owner. Mixed-owner rendering and outposts do not grant live colony details.

system-exploration.predicate: Planet roster and extended-range verdict require visited-or-native-omniscient non-black-hole system. Wormhole destination/known-empty requires visited or native omniscience, not destination-name knowledge. Use existing read-only Star_In_Extended_Range_Of_Player at coherent capture, including native odd-range rounding, blocks, visited-wormhole shortcut and alliances; no new movement math, ship-specific movement/ETA calculator or UI builder. Resolve only real same-capture systems/planets. Unknown differs from explored empty lists/known-empty wormholes. Temporary contact/Lore grants use existing whole-view revocation on mutation or observed loss, not a new cache/lease.

planets-explored.predicate: Filter system exploration before planet copying, validation, counts, IDs and events. Include all occupied orbits in visited-or-native-omniscient non-black-hole systems, plus independently authorized own full-colony locations. Public one-based physical orbit is distinct from compressed occupied-slot Roman name ordinal. Copy native asteroid/gas-giant/planet kind; ordinary planets expose size 0..4, gravity 0..2, base planet climate 0..9, minerals 0..4, special 1..10 (0 and Orion 11 known-empty), cached half-food units, native mineral productivity and read-only gravity penalty/hostile-environment suitability. Nonplanet ecology/name/suitability is known-empty. Copy bounded CP850 native no-Prime name without mutating shared temp buffers. No foreign colony climate/population/buildings/production, system reward or stale UI summary/hover/movement values. Native stores shared current planet data, not per-player historical ecology; do not invent last-known values. Opaque disclosed-location IDs are world/perspective scoped; retained captures immutable.

planet-suitability.predicate: Maximum population uses the native read-only Planet_Max_Population_For_Player only for an authorized ordinary uncolonized planet or own full colony, after validating own inputs. Foreign/outpost-dependent maximum population is unaudited and never calculated from alien live population/races/buildings. Preserve native 0..42 result, traits/mod tables and storage cap; no economic forecast or new calculator.

exploration-own-colony-links.predicate: Resolve reciprocal planet/own-full-colony references only through the same fresh capture's validated system/orbit graph and actual queryable planet/colony families. Never mint phantom planet handles, link a foreign colony or use historical handle tables as authority. Unknown when no authorized same-capture counterpart; not inferred known-empty foreign intelligence. Handles and immutable pages obey world/perspective revocation and ordinary indistinguishable unavailable errors.

disabled-system-owner.predicate: Pending per-field review of Star_Owner, mixed owners, visited/contact/lore and outpost semantics. Raw star.owner forbidden.

players-known.predicate: Bound active human viewer only. Include self and foreign empires listed by the native race screen: current contact, eliminated (even without contact), or native Player_Is_Omniscient including cached Galactic Lore. Prior contact alone is not current contact. Gate before reading bounded CP850 name/color; copy name, color, eliminated and living-foreign contact separately, not historical eliminated-contact flags, portraits/traits/government/research or hidden economy. Own name is also displayed by the self race report. Sort the authorized projection before assigning unpredictable perspective/game-scoped handles; no native slots, hidden counts or gaps in numbering are exposed. A temporarily absent empire cannot be looked up using an old handle.

player-own-economy.predicate: Only the bound local player's already calculated HUD values: bc, surplus_bc, surplus_food, n_freighters, surplus_freighters, command_points and native int16 command_points-minus-used result. Preserve signed deficits/known zero. Foreign treasury/HUD are explicitly unaudited and never read, even under native omniscience. Research display branches, forecasts, totals/maintenance and calculators are not enabled by this policy.

player-contact-war.predicate: Only a currently contacted living foreign empire in this same capture's authorized roster: copy whether the viewer's directed treaty entry is >=4, the native UI/diplomacy war classification. Read only the viewer's treaty array, not foreign attitude/treaty/AI state. Self, eliminated and uncontacted empires (including omniscience/Lore-only rows) return unknown, never an inferred false. Discard unavailable values before ordering, equality, revisions or notifications. Known false means a current living contact is not classified at war by the native treaty display; it is not a claim of safety, future intentions, or bilateral intelligence. No raw treaty codes, labels, payments or hidden exact attitudes are exposed.

player-contact-research-treaty.predicate: Only currently contacted living foreign empires in the same authorized roster. Copy whether the viewer's own directed research_treaty[target] is nonzero, the shared native race-screen summary gate. This player field reports presence only; detailed levels have their separate relations-contact policy. Self, eliminated and uncontacted rows including omniscience/Lore-only roster entries are unknown, not false. No reciprocal foreign flag, goal, research state or forecast. Sanitize unavailable values before sorting, equality, revisions or notifications; one coherent capture. No calculator or UI builder.

player-contact-trade-treaty.predicate: Only currently contacted living foreign empires in the same authorized roster. Copy whether the viewer's own directed trade_treaty[target] is nonzero, the shared native race-screen summary gate. This player field reports presence only; detailed levels have their separate relations-contact policy. Self, eliminated and uncontacted rows including omniscience/Lore-only roster entries are unknown, not false. No reciprocal foreign flag, economic base, goal or forecast. Sanitize unavailable values before sorting, equality, revisions or notifications; one coherent capture. No calculator or UI builder.

disabled-planet.predicate: Pending read-only equivalent of native explored-planet policy; do not invoke a mutable list builder. Orbit/name/type separately gated.

colonies-own.predicate: This list is explicitly the bound active human viewer's own full-colony roster, following native Colonies/transport lists: owner equals viewer and outpost_flag is zero. Foreign intelligence and outposts are not included. Filter before reading links/population, sorting, counts, handles, revisions or notifications. At the same map/roster capture, copy a validated system reference and one-based orbital position and cached n_pops resident population (0..42 whole displayed population units, not thousandths, growth or inbound settlers). Validate planet/star/colony backlinks and uniqueness. Resolve system/owner through the same capture; discard private bindings before retention. No UI list builder, Sum_Colonists, forecast or economic calculator is called. Opaque read-only observation handles are replaced on authorized collection changes, not durable colony identities/action capabilities. Known-empty refers to this own-full-colony scope, not to foreign intelligence.

colony-own-troops.predicate: Only the bound active human viewer's own full colonies after owner/outpost authorization and parent-link validation. Copy existing military[0] infantry and military[1] armor counts, 0..32767 native int16 units, including known zero. Print_Scanned_Military displays these exact counts; Do_Colony_Info_Military_Stuff_For draws the units or the exact compressed count. Armor covers the native tank/battloid presentation, not a newly inferred unit design. Do not add population militia, inbound troops, troop strength, growth/roundoff, future production, weapon/armor technology or foreign/outpost intelligence. No troop popup, UI builder, invasion limit or combat calculator is invoked. Same immutable map/ship/roster/colony capture as population; hidden-only counts do not affect handles, revisions or notifications.

colony-operations.predicate: Own full colonies only through shared Own_Full_Colony, before detail reads, validation, counts or equality. Shared native population/product/autobuild labels, presence and satellite redundancy, resource icon-group arithmetic and morale icon rounding/suppression/cap; native job/species/localized unit text, event priority and labels, inbound-settler count, current product cost, stored/bought production, cached-industry turn count and own-only buy predicate. Seven committed queue slots retain none/repeat/refit variants and labels, not design/ship entity grants. Unknown variants/storage/resources are explicit unknown, not no production or empty workforce. No foreign treasury, population recalculation, economic refresh, UI list construction, staged queue/refit design, transfer verdict/ETA, RNG or report consumption. Native edit staging blocks fresh ambient capture; retained combined captures stay dated and are never enriched. Initialized settled colony decision points publish coherent ambient data. Recipient-scoped pre-replacement invalidation revokes dependent colony/planet pages, references and queued leased output before authority/storage mutation, preserving other ambient reads. Resolve species-player links only through the same capture's existing roster; a species/product label grants no additional entity. Outposts and foreign colony intelligence remain excluded.

ships-refreshed.predicate: Two independently authorized capture paths for the bound active human outside mutation/resolution/staged colony edits or temporary-player overrides. Ambient owned inspection enumerates only own active status 0..2 records, as the Fleets presentation with both type filters enabled, without invoking its mutable builders. Other ships still require synchronous surviving associations post-Build_Ship_Icons: fresh displayed icon/stack heads and reachable members, never unlinked allocations or later node traversal. An ambient owned capture does not retain or enlarge foreign observations. Copy only authorized position/classification, with separate name/owner/detail/route policies. Fresh contextual fleet-box captures reuse validated surviving associations under ship-map-eta. All selected topics belong to one immutable capture; never enrich older snapshots. Publicly sort before opaque observation handles; no slots, rebuilt stack IDs, durable identity or action capability. Changed public collections replace handle sets; retirement, replacement and storage/authority loss revoke dependent pages and output.

ship-own-name.predicate: Ship.name is the canonical in-game name, never a hull/type label or a new displayName. Only an independently included active owned ship: bounded NUL-terminated d.name decoded from CP850 in the same ambient/refresh/context capture. Foreign name bytes are never read; a disclosed hull label does not authorize a canonical foreign name. Queue/refit labels have their independent Design projection, not phantom map-positioned Ship records.

ship-owner-known.predicate: Only an independently included own active ship or surviving refresh observation. Own ownership resolves to the bound player's same-capture roster handle. Foreign banner-color mapping requires a unique color in that authorized roster; ambiguous, unlisted and NPC owners remain unaudited. No old handle table/newer roster linking. Discard private owner bindings before retention; compare only public IDs. Ownership grants no foreign names/designs/routes/ETA/cargo/orders/economy.

ship-map-route.predicate: Owned active groups use the unconditional own-route branch of Do_Ship_Destination_Lines in coherent ambient inspection or refresh captures. Other ambient routes still require surviving refresh associations and a non-own moving head with enemy_moves or Enemy_Ship_Heading_Toward_Our_Colony; preserve its non-own (not hostile) meaning and the outpost predicate's ignored player argument. Members share only validated grouping location/owner/position. Contextual non-own destination requires an actual selected/open-box route line in the same initialized main-owner frame before its actual non-preview fleet-box cached producer. Require status-2 upper-offset departure or status-1 lower-offset transit; reject mixed encodings. Open box, selection, copied destination and map-icon ETA alone are not grants. Validate exact head and complete membership under ship-map-eta. Resolve only real same-capture systems, not unvisited names or special/Antares destinations. Producer star -1 withholds the name, not drawn position and not known-empty. Stationary own routes are known-empty. Revoke contextual route and ETA together through pages, subscriptions, bridge and every output fragment; preserve independent ambient data. Detection, contact and omniscience alone never authorize routes. No query invokes builders, renderers or movement calculation.

ship-map-eta.predicate: Preserve cached uint8 turns_left, including zero/255, only with a current same-capture destination; never calculate ETA. Ambient lower-encoding ETA belongs to the native ordered group head: shared Member_Order for owned inspection, surviving displayed head for other refresh observations. Members do not inherit it. Upper-encoding ETA remains contextual: actual non-preview fleet-box producer for a surviving own/non-own head with independent ambient destination, or the contextual departing/transit head authorized by ship-map-route. Require initialized active main owner/presentation, exact complete current open-box membership and no stale selected references; empty selection is valid. Recheck foreign enemy_moves/incoming-colony/outpost gates; a newly enabled gate cannot promote an old association. Contextual destination needs actual same-frame route drawing, not map-icon ETA. Associations are captured only at refresh; private generation/owner/location/status/position checks reject retirement and slot/node reuse without later node traversal or foreign-name fingerprints. Publish a fresh immutable capture of all selected topics including session, never enrich older captures. Revoke route/ETA together on owner/box exit or replacement, interruption, rebuild, storage/identity/world/perspective loss and resolution, through retained/pinned captures, pending baselines, bridge and every output fragment. Started revoked output closes; independently authorized ambient reads remain. Equal re-presentation may retain public handles/revision but never revive expired pages. Other moving non-head/upper ETA is context-required, stationary own ETA known-empty, special destinations get no fabricated handles. No extra foreign names/designs/cargo/orders or hostility inference.

disabled-ship.predicate: Unmapped/special owner identities and enemy canonical names/scan details require independent native authorization and initialized-context visibility tests. A hull-class label is not the canonical ship name. Surviving detection or known ownership does not authorize raw location, cargo, orders or enemy design data. No scanner-policy extraction is needed for the post-refresh projection.

owned-fleet-inspection.predicate: Only bound-player active ships (native status 0..2). Shared Same_Fleet uses native owner/location/x/y grouping; Member_Order preserves native type/size/picture ordering. Lists are unfiltered owned collections independent of current selection and combat/support toggles. Members resolve only through the same capture. Group IDs are read-observation handles, never rebuilt stack IDs or durable fleet identities. Location, destination and unsigned cached head ETA retain the independent ship route policies; members do not inherit head ETA. No mutable list builder or movement calculator runs. Retire, replacement, authority/storage loss revoke dependent handles, pages and leased output, preserving independent ambient topics.

owned-ship-inspection.predicate: Only bound-player active ships independently included by owned Fleets inspection. Shared Condition, Subsystem_Maxima, damaged-drive speed and Shield_Strength preserve native integer conversions/rounding, signed exceptional structure values and the separately wider displayed shield maximum. Subsystem ratios and maximum shield strength are withheld where noncombat/strategic layouts suppress them; native displayed zero speed and strategic 0/0 armor remain displayed zero, not an ETA or inferred equipment absence. Undefined shield-zero-maximum input is unavailable, not fabricated zero. Bonuses use audited pure design/crew/officer/owner-trait producers, not combat predictions. Combat EP is displayed crew experience; noncombat EP is unknown. Captured/special structure retains previous-owner semantics without granting foreign player records. Cargo is unknown. Same-capture location/configuration links only. Canonical names remain separate from type labels. Queue/refit inspection is a Design disclosure, not a Ship dossier. Ambient reads require no navigation; contextual routes remain narrower.

owned-design-inspection.predicate: Committed owned slots and independently authorized own active configurations, plus committed owned-full-colony queued/refit configurations from Draw_Ship_Info. Sources slot/ship/queued/refit are distinct: never infer a slot match from a name, hull or equipment equality. No pending refit, staged MOX::design, generated candidate or uncommitted queued record. Current automatic strategic ship equipment uses pure Copy_Current_Ship_Configuration shared with the native updater, without invoking that updater or generating a candidate. Build_Weapon_String supplies native production/refit labels; Weapon_Mod_String and cached Weapon_Arc_String supply committed-slot/active configuration details in their native 128-byte buffers. Queued/refit hull labels, arc, postfix modifiers, current counts and damage are unknown where their presentation does not disclose them. Their constructionColony resolves only through the same authorized colony capture; no Ship record is manufactured. Type-zero slots are omitted, nonzero zero-count slots retained. Active noncombat weapon suppression follows Load_Display_Combat_Ship; active specials honor the native regeneration presentation switch. Cost is stored production points, including refit-specific stored cost, never BC or a recalculated price. Names/components come from initialized native resources; arc labels initialize/reload with native strings, not during capture. No Calculate_Design, mutable initializer, foreign scan/options/action or durable identity.

disabled-design.predicate: Own templates or actual active scan-authorized details; calculators must be audited for mutation before sharing.

leaders-roster.predicate: Bound local human perspective only. Shared Officer_Roster_Disclosure gates before copying: own nonnegative-status roster, distinguishing status 4 hiring pool from hired service, plus the actual pending officer_for_hire with matching owner/status -1. Never enumerate generated candidates, undiscovered marooned leaders or foreign records. Native ship/colony roles, bounded names/titles, computed localized rank; XP only for roster entries, not pending popup-only offers. Unclassified nonnegative native states are unavailable, not invented assignments. Capacity 67 includes leaders_no_limit. Publicly sort after projection; read handles are capture-scoped, not durable slot identities. Withdrawal/replacement revokes retained pages/output through existing perspective revocation. Transient rescue/ground-summary disclosures have no ambient roster grant.

leader-abilities.predicate: Only authorized roster/offer entries or an initialized promotion/rescue result ability presentation. Share native Officer_Displays_Skill and Copy_Officer_Skill_Value with Print_Officer_Data: role-specific skills first then general skills, retaining native order, localized names and formatted displayed values from Officer_Skill_Bonus. Ground summaries and message names do not grant ability rows. No raw masks, cost score, effectiveness inference or reinterpretation of value units. At most 54 native skill rows.

leaders-disclosed.predicate: Bound human recipient and initialized native result owner only, never an ambient foreign record grant. Shared leader_read projections are consumed by native presentations and copied synchronously by RPC. Promotion/rescue results disclose ranked name/title, role and displayed abilities, not roster XP/assignment/costs/upkeep. Only status 1 with positive cached eta draws the portrait arrival-ETA overlay; an absent overlay is unknown, not known-empty. NEWPUP and COLGCBT disclose only the native 52-byte ranked-name presentation and contextual officer_bonus when officer_idx > 0; preserve that producer gate including slot zero exclusion. The contextual bonus is a displayed ground-summary value, not a leader effectiveness API. The leader-bearing Freak Accident event variant requires an actual complete name substitution in the recipient's selected message and its matching initialized GNN/text-box presentation; private arguments and formatting calls alone confer no authority. Unknown partial fields remain explicit; no foreign masks, XP or assignment are copied. Owner exit, replacement and interruption revoke context leases, handles, pinned pages and queued output before native cleanup; parent return needs fresh presentation. During resolution only an explicitly stamped leader-only projection is readable, anchored to the committed turn; no new turn publication or enrichment of older combined state. Fresh nonbusy captures may combine independently authorized ambient topics with disclosures; assignment references remain same-capture only. No persistent dossier or help descriptions.

leader-assignment.predicate: Native status 0 unassigned and 2 limbo have known-empty assignment/ETA. Status 1 displays a ship name or system name; positive cached eta is travel turns, zero is known-empty travel ETA. Other states have unknown assignment/ETA. Never calculate transfer options or ETA. Link system/own ship only through the same capture; an authorized displayed assignment can have unknown target reference if the ship was not captured. No colony assignment. Context-derived ship handles inherit existing snapshot leases.

leader-costs.predicate: Native Calculate_Officer_Cost in whole BC only for actual pending offers and personal hiring pool, not hired leaders. Officer_Maintenance supplies displayed BC per turn for authorized hired/offer entries, including zero-maintenance skills and Loknar. Reuse native read-only cost functions, never Officer_Skill_Value recalculation or hiring operations.

leader-offer.predicate: Status 4 personal hiring-pool remaining availability is 30 minus native eta, as displayed; not an arrival ETA. Pending offers have no audited expiry. Native Leader_Technology_String prose is available only for actual offers/pool entries and initialized persistent language tables, not a grant of hidden research references or predicted outcomes. Do not generate offers or consume reports. Decline retains a pool entry; expiry/dismissal/death/removal/replacement revoke old authorization.

disabled-leader-description.predicate: Help descriptions are screen_seg-owned and unavailable to ambient reads; never borrow stale pointers or invoke the screen loader/renderers.

retained-messages.predicate: Only the bound active human recipient's native retained s_MSG slice, independently available through Info without showing the popup. Share Copy_Message_Text with sprintf_msg, including every supported type and all twelve colony subtypes, native 256-byte final buffer and localized intermediate truncation. Shared caller-buffer planet and refit product formatting writes no selection/scratch state; artifact conjunction initializes with native language/mod strings. Serious is exactly Is_Serious_Msg, not invented severity/category; ordering is native queue order or stable serious-first partition, not chronology. No occurrence turn or per-entry read status exists. Unknown type 3/unrecognized variants have unknown text. Native summary replacement, capacity eviction and reset end retention; no persistent archive. A recipient-scoped neutral pre-insertion/replacement publication expires handles, pinned pages and queued output before mutation; rejected/foreign insertions cannot churn the public projection. Existing resolution/world boundaries expire summary reads before queue allocation. Busy until a fresh complete coherent capture; never splice a later summary into an older ship capture. Colony links follow native Message_Colony ownership and resolve only an independently authorized same-capture own-full-colony handle. Names in text grant no foreign entity records.
